examples.text: The kitten is being fed on demand.

trans.sense: medical condition, sufferers of which stop breathing if they fall asleep

examples.text: Ondine’s curse—more appropriately known as congenital central hypoventilation syndrome, or CCHS—is a rare, severe form of sleep apnea in which an individual completely stops breathing when falling asleep.
